failures.message: passed at base_sha, so it proves nothing about this change — `prepare_worktree` takes a `sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep` keyword, and its one retry pause calls that keyword rather than reaching `time.sleep` by the module attribute it calls directly today, at `time.sleep(_RETRY_PAUSE_S)` (saffron/cell/worktree.py:151). The same keyword, at the same default, already names this convention twice: `follow()`'s `sleep: Callable[[float], bool] = _sleep_and_continue` (saffron/watch.py:178) and `run_stack_batch()`'s `sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep` (saffron/batch.py:423). The witness overrides only that keyword, while a guard makes the real `time.sleep` raise if the pause ever reaches it some other way, following `tests/test_batch.py:294-303`'s own `_raise_on_real_sleep`.
